import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,base64,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys
l=Path.cwd();rows=json.loads(Path('literal-provenance.json').read_text());r=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());assert set(r)==set(map(str,json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']))
for x in rows:
 raw=base64.b64decode(x['raw_base64']);token=base64.b64decode(x['statement_token_base64']);o=json.loads(raw)
 assert o==x['object'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==x['raw_sha256'] and json.loads(token)==o['statement'] and hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest()==x['statement_token_sha256'] and hashlib.sha256(o['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['decoded_sha256']
inv=json.loads(Path('history-access.json').read_text());blocked=['formal','code-loop','polynexus','crown','bunkbed','tournament','hat','expanded-corpus-r463','expanded-corpus-r466','expanded-corpus-r467','expanded-corpus-r395','percolation-hub-source-review']
bad=[x['path'] for x in inv if x['action']=='read' and any(any(t in part.lower() for t in blocked) for part in Path(x['path']).relative_to(l.parent).parts)]
assert not bad
led=Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True);prev='0'*64;att=[]
for i,b in enumerate(led):
 o=json.loads(b);assert o['seq']==i and o['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
 if o['event']=='attempt':att.append(o)
assert len(att)==7
budget=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());charges=[json.loads(s) for s in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert budget['calls_used']==len(charges)==1 and budget['queries_used']==3
json.loads(Path('search-response1.json').read_text())
audit={'literal_bindings':20,'results':20,'history_entries':len(inv),'protected_reads_in_saved_inventory':bad,'guard_hops':len(att),'guard_chain_terminal':prev,'native_search_calls':1,'native_queries':3,'failed_receipts':[p.name for p in l.glob('*.receipt.json') if json.loads(p.read_text()).get('exit')!=0],'scope':'Own saved inventory audit only; no external protected files followed.'}
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(l/'write_lane.py'),'final-audit.json'],input=json.dumps(audit,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print(json.dumps(audit))
